missions.referral.body: Copy this link or code to invite a new member into Timeblock.

ops.agent_api.title: Admin API for AI Agent
ops.agent_api.intro: Admin status page for the audited API that lets an AI agent create missions, shop content, events, email operations, and operational updates.
ops.agent_api.token_note: The token is never revealed in the UI.
ops.agent_api.origins_note: Blank means the app layer does not restrict origins.
ops.agent_api.usage_note: Send Authorization: Bearer <token>, a valid Origin when configured, and X-Request-ID on write requests for traceable audit logs.
ops.agent_api.one_time_secret_note: Copy this value now. It will not be shown again and must never be committed to GitHub, n8n exports or screenshots.
ops.agent_api.managed_note: Use a separate key for the external ChatGPT Admin Action. Only the scopes listed here are granted.
ops.agent_api.empty_keys: No managed key has been created.
ops.google_ads.title: Google Auto Ads
ops.google_ads.intro: AdSense policy remediation: pause serving, verify the canonical domain, and only re-enable ads on high-value content pages.
ops.google_ads.client_note: Used by google-adsense-account meta and Auto Ads script.
ops.google_ads.publisher_note: Must match the value published at /ads.txt.
ops.google_ads.script_note: The script is injected only when Auto Ads is enabled and ADSENSE_CLIENT is set.
ops.google_ads.review_mode_note: When enabled, no page loads Google Ads scripts.
ops.google_ads.serving_note: Keep this off until content and the production domain pass review.
ops.google_ads.canonical_note: The Render subdomain redirects to prevent duplicate public copies.
ops.google_ads.violation_duplicate_body: Google found ads on screens with embedded or copied content without enough original commentary, curation or added value. Keep ads off aggregated data, assistant, auth, clickout and thin utility screens.
ops.google_ads.violation_low_value_body: Some screens do not contain enough original publisher content or mainly serve navigation/actions. Add substantial guidance, sources, authorship, update dates and a clear purpose before ads return.
ops.google_ads.step_1: Deploy remediation mode and confirm no Google Ads script or slot remains on public pages.
ops.google_ads.step_2: Use fumapgo.com as canonical and remove or redirect the Render subdomain site in AdSense.
ops.google_ads.step_3: Manually audit original content, legal pages, contact, privacy and navigation; only then request review.
ops.google_ads.notice: Do not request review until this build is deployed and production View Source checks are complete.
business.module.business_api_wallet.summ: Read internal-point wallet and Internal FGO through business API.
business.api_wallet.title: Timeblock wallet and Internal FGO API
business.api_wallet.intro: Businesses can use read-only API access to sync internal points, Internal FGO, and block-ledger activity into their own systems.
business.api_wallet.pending_note: Points waiting for processing or reconciliation.
business.api_wallet.fgo_note: Internal entitlement unit in this phase.
business.api_wallet.api_body: Request a token in integrations, choose wallet/FGO scopes, wait for admin approval, then call the API with a Bearer token.
business.api_wallet.wallet_endpoint: Returns internal points, Internal FGO, and recent activity ledger.
business.api_wallet.fgo_endpoint: Returns Internal FGO status and point-conversion eligibility under current policy.
business.api_wallet.activity_body: Recent block-ledger records connected to the business wallet.
business.api_wallet.notice: Timeblock points and Internal FGO are internal platform usage and entitlement units, not cash, investment products, or externally withdrawable/tradable crypto assets.
utilities.card.business_api_wallet.title: Business wallet/FGO API
utilities.card.business_api_wallet.body: Connect a business system to internal points and Internal FGO through scoped API access.
